Grades 1–6

Grade School

Children build strong academic foundations and practice applying Christian values in their relationships and everyday choices.

Grades 1–6

What children learn

Read, reason, and communicate

Learners develop comprehension and numeracy, explain what they think, and work through problems with others.

Practice faith in daily life

Bible study supports the development of humility, discipline, and a Christ-like attitude.

Keep families involved

Parents and teachers communicate about learning and help children develop habits they can use at school and at home.

Entry guidance

Contact Admissions for grade placement and the current document checklist.
